Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-acc-A-extprompt-cache.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator'. ST's clearChat (script.js:1590) reassigns extension_prompts = {} on every chat load, including a same-chat reloadCurrentChat. stHost/extensionPrompts.ts dedupes writes through a module-level lastWritten map that nothing resets on a chat load, so setStoryExtensionPrompt(key, sameText, sameDepth) after the wipe returns changed:false and writes nothing. The probe sets a nudge (injected), reloads the same chat (the block is gone), sets the SAME nudge again (expected injected; the defect leaves it absent while getActiveNudge() still reports it), and a control sets a DIFFERENT text (injected). It asserts the correct behaviour, so it is RED while the defect stands. Finally the nudge is cleared (which also clears the cache entry).
